name: twiga-agm
description: Property Management System for Twiga Residence

scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev -w apps/web & npm run dev -w apps/admin & wait'
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w packages/functions && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/admin
